body.purpose: Default for labels, buttons, textareas, prose.

label.purpose: Uppercase section eyebrows above content blocks.

mono.purpose: Token text, probabilities, prompt/template previews — anything that is literal model output or a number.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Rest-state lift on key content blocks (prompt, output, probs, final-prompt preview) and hover/active on turn-blocks.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Page-level floating notices (model-swap banner). Only tier that fully detaches from the document.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Probability bar fill animating to its measured width.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(20% 0.012 280); color: oklch(99% 0.005 280); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(34% 0.010 280); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: oklch(65% 0.006 280); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Stop action; also the general outline-button pattern.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: oklch(99% 0.005 280); color: oklch(34% 0.010 280); border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.006 280); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: oklch(95% 0.011 280); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: oklch(65% 0.006 280); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Tab
components.description: Top nav item; active tab gets the Signal Blue underline.
components.css: .ds-tab { background: none; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: oklch(50% 0.008 280); font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: oklch(20% 0.012 280); } .ds-tab-active { color: oklch(20% 0.012 280); border-bottom-color: oklch(55% 0.20 255); }

components.name: Token Chip
components.description: Clickable generated token; selected state shows its probability chart.
components.css: .ds-token { cursor: pointer; padding: 0 1px; border-radius: 2px; transition: background 0.1s ease; } .ds-token:hover { background: oklch(95% 0.012 280); } .ds-token-selected { background: oklch(88% 0.10 255); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(55% 0.20 255) inset; }

components.name: Probability Bar Row
components.description: Signature component: one row of the top-10 probability bar chart.

components.css: .ds-bar-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.5rem 1fr 3.5rem; gap: 0.6rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.2rem 0; font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-bar-label { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; color: oklch(34% 0.010 280); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-bar-track { height: 0.7rem; background: oklch(95% 0.011 280); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar-fill { height: 100%; background: oklch(55% 0.20 255); border-radius: 999px; transition: width 0.15s ease; } .ds-bar-pct { font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.78rem; color: oklch(50% 0.008 280); text-align: right; }

components.name: Tool Call Block
components.description: Signature component: Tab ④ agent tool-call turn block.
components.css: .ds-turn-call { background: oklch(96% 0.030 320); color: oklch(54% 0.22 320); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Tool Result Block
components.description: Signature component: Tab ④ agent tool-result turn block, answers a Tool Call Block.
components.css: .ds-turn-result { background: oklch(96% 0.026 145); color: oklch(50% 0.15 145); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-family: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace; }

components.name: Swap Toast
components.description: Signature component: floating model-swap loading indicator. Only element allowed to shadow-float above content.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: oklch(96% 0.045 255); color: oklch(55% 0.20 255); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 0.875rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(20% 0.012 280 / 0.15); } .ds-toast-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: oklch(55% 0.20 255); animation: ds-pulse 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a whiteboard, not a stage. It stays quiet by default so the model's actual behavior — the tokens, the probability bars, the tool calls — reads as the content, not the UI around it. Color and elevation are reserved for the moments something real is happening: a token is selected, a probability bar fills in, a tool call fires, a result comes back. Everything else stays in a tight, cool-neutral grayscale so those moments read as signal, not noise.

This system explicitly rejects generic SaaS marketing chrome (gradient heroes, icon+heading+text cards), gamified flourish (badges, celebratory motion, progress-bar theatrics), and enterprise-dashboard cliché (navy-and-cream, dense identical card grids). Nothing here should look decorative — a tool whose whole premise is "no magic" cannot have UI chrome that performs sophistication it doesn't need.
keyCharacteristics: Cool-neutral grayscale base (all neutrals share a 280° hue tint) with three semantic accents, never a decorative one
Flat by default; a light elevation tier is reserved for surfaces that need to visually detach (hover states, the model-swap toast)
Monospace reserved for anything that is literally model output or a number (tokens, probabilities, prompts)
One accent per meaning: blue = primary interaction, violet = tool call, green = tool result — never mixed

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue, Call Violet, and Return Green each mean exactly one thing. None of the three is ever reused as a decorative accent, a "brand" color, or a fourth meaning.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Across any given screen, colored surface area (all three accents plus tints combined) stays under 10%. The whiteboard is the point; color is the exception that proves something is happening.

rules.name: The Flat Scale Warning
rules.body: Today's type hierarchy sits mostly within a narrow 0.75–0.875rem band. Legible but nearly flat — look for a legitimate Title-level moment before defaulting back to Body everywhere.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Rule
rules.body: There are exactly two shadow tiers: ambient-low for the key content blocks at rest (and in-flow hover/active), toast for anything that floats above the page. Everything else stays bordered-flat at rest.

dos: Do keep all neutrals tinted to the same 280° hue — never mix in a pure-gray or a different hue of neutral.
Do keep Signal Blue / Call Violet / Return Green each locked to their one meaning (interaction / tool-call / tool-result).
Do switch to monospace the moment content is literal model output or a number that needs to line up.
Do use borders, not shadows, for surfaces at rest; reserve shadow for the two named tiers.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on every transition.
donts: Don't add gradient hero sections, big rounded icon+heading+text marketing cards, or any generic SaaS landing-page chrome.
Don't add gamified flourish: colorful badges, progress-bar celebration animations, confetti, or playful mascots.
Don't reach for an enterprise-dashboard palette (navy + cream) or dense grids of identical cards.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe on any card, list item, or callout.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism-as-default, or the SaaS hero-metric template.
Don't let the three accent colors exceed roughly 10% combined surface area on any one screen.
